'''Administrator General''' was a title within the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the position was held by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Lalat'k]].<ref name="TOR" />
